title: shoalkit: linear & Stokes wave transformation with theory gating
description: A small, citable Python wrapper for linear water-wave dispersion and deepwater-to-depth transformation (the CACR/UDel wave-calculator output set), with closed-form Airy and second-order Stokes elevation, a raschii bridge for higher-order Stokes / Fenton profiles, and the Ursell number with a transparent wave-theory applicability gate.
